item.title: Easy-to-Ride Bikes For Heavy Traffic In India
item.description: Choosing easy-to-ride bikes for heavy traffic is essential for daily city commuting, where handling, comfort and low-speed control matter most. Motorcycles like the Triumph Speed 400, Royal Enfield Hunter 350, Harley-Davidson X440, Yamaha MT-15 V2 and TVS Apache RTR 160 are commonly considered for urban riding due to their manageable power delivery, upright ergonomics and traffic-friendly size.
